_about: Distractors swapped for another grammar point of the same quiz (wrong in that slot), so the quiz title can't be used to rule options out. Applied by tools/apply_distractor_fixes.py (hand-written quizzes) and by the generators (N1, Mandarin). 'old' is the option's plain text, 'new' uses furigana markup.
